packaging_audit.detail: The two newly authored MODE_OFF documentation artifacts were initially written under the maintained Cloud-BAL tree, then moved to this isolated PR83 worktree after preserving their byte hashes. The maintained copies are absent. No source, input, runtime output, native receipt, prior receipt, or graph snapshot was changed by the correction. The control record was subsequently refreshed to point to the final _20261013f WPS witness/readback, _20261013d native receipt and Xb output, v2 paired inventory, same13 PR82 reread, and blocked prior preflight. The preserved historical _c/_b outputs are identified separately. An older _d-located readback was found to embed PR82 Xa hashes; it is retained and explicitly marked MISBOUND_EXPLORATORY_ONLY. The current OFF initial field readback was rerun against the _d receipt, OFF input, and OFF wrfout with receipt/file hash binding. Shared native-runner extraction is post-model; the current pre-refactor OFF source is archived at its actual SHA, and the executed _20261013d source hash b84f... is recorded as unavailable source bytes rather than reconstructed. The P2 field readback now binds input/output SHA-256 to the supplied native run receipt and rechecks all three sources after inspection; actual OFF _d and actual PR82 _final4 readbacks both passed with their matching receipts. The OFF runner is now a thin wrapper over the shared native initializer; only API/CLI/focused tests ran after this refactor. A receipt-contract regression also verifies that a successful prior writes the PR83 schema at the exact filename consumed by the PR83 reader. The successful-prior regression exercises the same production receipt-writer used by the shared runner, then reads back the expected PR83 receipt schema and basename. The shared runner keeps PR82 runtime-copy behavior unchanged; the OFF wrapper alone excludes its prior namelist.input.source before writing the pinned effective namelist.
